messages.content: Implement a Python function from a JSON behavioral card. The card is the only task specification. Return a JSON object with a single string field code containing executable Python source. Define solve with the card's exact signature. Use only Python's standard library. Allowed imports: math, itertools, functools, collections, heapq, bisect, statistics, fractions, operator, typing. Do not import or call NumPy, SymPy, NetworkX or any other third-party library. Do not read files, use network, introspection, eval, exec, input or print. Implement computations yourself using built-ins and the allowed standard library. Return plain JSON-compatible values, not iterators or sets; use string keys in dictionaries. Include any helper functions in the code. No tests or main block. Raise ValueError where the card requires it.

Implement this card:
{
  "algorithm": [
    "Perform a Breadth-First Search (BFS) starting from the given node to explore all reachable vertices in the undirected graph.",
    "Track visited vertices to avoid cycles and ensure each vertex is processed once.",
    "Collect all vertices visited during BFS to form the connected component.",
    "Sort the collected vertices in ascending order to produce the output list."
  ],
  "constraints": [
    "The graph is simple and undirected with vertices 0 to n-1",
    "Edges are distinct and satisfy 0<=u<v<n",
    "The graph may contain isolated vertices",
    "The output must be a sorted list of vertex strings",
    "The function assumes the graph is undirected and does not handle directed graphs"
  ],
  "edge_cases": [
    "Graph with a single node (no edges): returns [str(node)]",
    "Node is isolated (no edges connected to it): returns [str(node)]",
    "Graph with multiple disconnected components: returns only the component containing the specified node",
    "Input node is the only node in the graph: returns [str(node)]"
  ],
  "inputs": "n: integer >= 1; edges: list of distinct [u,v] pairs with 0<=u<v<n; node: valid vertex in the graph",
  "method_id": "networkx.node_connected_component",
  "output": "Ascending list of vertices (as strings) in the connected component containing the specified node.",
  "purpose": "Return the ascending list of vertices in the connected component of a simple undirected graph that contains a specified node, including isolated vertices.",
  "signature": "solve(n, edges, node)"
}
